parts.html: A 65 m² apartment in Kharkiv where we carried out the full scope of work: interior design, technical documentation, furniture design and manufacturing, and a turnkey renovation. The project covered the living room combined with the kitchen and dining area, the bedroom, a walk-in closet, the entrance hall, and the bathroom. For each area we designed made-to-measure furniture, including cabinets and shelves.

Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate for the work, building materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. The gallery shows the 3D visualizations and photos of the finished apartment.

The kitchen, dining room, and living room share one space with a panoramic window and access to the balcony. The kitchen is a single run: white high-gloss base units with walnut-colored handle profiles, and wall cabinets with black glass fronts. The backsplash and floor are large-format white marble-effect tiles, and the oven is built into a tall unit. A dining table with a black top stands by the window.

Opposite the sofa, the TV hangs on a gray wall above a low black high-gloss media unit. A bioethanol fireplace in a steel frame is built into the wall, and next to it a walnut veneer panel runs from floor to ceiling. The lighting consists of recessed spotlights, black track lights, and a chandelier with glass shades over the table.

The bedroom has a dark wood floor, and the wall by the window and the ceiling bulkhead above the curtains are clad in the same walnut veneer, with surface-mounted lights set into the bulkhead. The headboard is made of soft white panels across the full width of the wall, with a pair of wall sconces above. Opposite is a narrow walnut console shelf and a mirror.

The walk-in closet is a separate U-shaped room: two tiers of hanging rails, a bank of drawers, and open shelves up to the ceiling. The entrance hall has a sliding-door wardrobe with mirrored doors and a walnut-effect wall panel, and the interior doors are in the same veneer.

The bathroom is tiled in white marble-effect tile. Above the wall-hung toilet is a narrow walnut-lined niche with shelves, and by the sink is a long illuminated mirror. To see how we design and make furniture like this, visit the custom furniture page.
